case_number: 2025 INSC 38; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION NO. 63 OF 2025

parties.petitioner: Principal Commissioner of Income Tax-4 & Anr.

summary: Reduction in share capital and extinguishment of rights under s.2(47) of Income Tax Act, 1961; applicability of Kartikeya V. Sarabhai (1997) 7 SCC 524; capital loss claim allowed by ITAT upheld; High Court affirmed; Revenue appeal dismissed; no change in shareholding percentage or face value; receipt of consideration along with reduced shares constitutes transfer; extinguishment of rights held sufficient even without sale or change in voting rights; preponderance of rights extinguished, not percentage; impugned judgment affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Kartikeya V. Sarabhai v. CIT (1997) 7 SCC 524
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; no error found in impugned judgment; order of High Court affirming ITAT upheld.
